general.notes: Solution is a pair: SO-SFP28-BX10D-2733 (1270 nm nominal) and SO-SFP28-BX10D-3327 (1330 nm nominal). Footnotes 1) and 2) assign wavelength ranges to each ordering variant. Transmitter/receiver wavelength ranges swap between the two parts. Power budget stated as 1.5 - 11 dB in TECHNICAL DATA; ordering descriptions list 11.5 dB. Output power, minimum input power, and overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload specified at 25GE and BER 5x10-5 (footnote 4). FEC is required in host equipment for 25G Ethernet; optical parameters target BER 5 x 10-5. Dispersion penalty max 2.7 dB stated without a paired penalized parameter and operating condition in penalty-point form. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C same as operating.
general.suggestions: Add schema fields for power_budget_db (min/max), dispersion_penalty_db_max, storage_temp range, DDM yes/no, and BiDi pair wavelength mapping per orderable SKU.
